subject: POC next steps and evaluation checklist for Lighthouse Systems
body:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
To: Carmen Lopez <carmen.lopez@lighthousesystems.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@lighthousesystems.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC next steps and evaluation checklist for Lighthouse Systems

Hi Carmen + Ben —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our demo and a proposed POC plan so your team can align internally. I tried to keep this tightly focused on the success criteria and ownership we discussed.

Summary of ask from Lighthouse: evaluate Redwood inference for (1) sub-second 95th P99 latency on targeted queries, (2) inference cost within budget envelope for 50k monthly sessions, and (3) secure VPC deployment for PHI-adjacent logs.

Proposed 3-week POC (high level) — start date target: week of Apr 4:
- Week 0 (prep, 3 business days): sign off on MA/NDA (received), build a mutual action plan, grant sandbox access, exchange network allowlists.
- Week 1 (integration): connect a test dataset, validate model selection and routing policy with sample traffic (Marissa + Rishi lead).
- Week 2 (load & quality): run 10k synthetic sessions + 500 real sessions, measure latencies, token cost, and accuracy on three evaluation prompts (Vanessa owner for success gating).
- Week 3 (wrap & review): deliver final report, recommend config for production roll, review open items and next steps.

Success criteria (pass/fail signal):
1) 95th percentile latency < 800ms for 8k-12k token aggregate workload on the selected model variant.
2) Token cost < $0.015 per interaction on average (batching & cache applied).
3) No data exfiltration risk: private VPC peering + KMS-managed keys in place.
4) Quality: >85% of 100 sampled outputs labeled as acceptable by Ben/Carmen SME (we will co-annotate).

RACI (short):
- Customer technical lead: Ben Turner — provide test dataset, deploy test traffic.
- Customer security/compliance: Carmen Lopez — validate network/KMS controls.
- Redwood: Rishi Malhotra (SE) — integration, network checklist; Marissa Cole (CS) — program management and reporting; Vanessa Ortiz (AE) — POC success owner and executive touchpoint.

Attachments included: redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx (detailed tasks and dates), redwood-network-reqs.pdf (firewall/KMS checklist).

Immediate asks:
1) Can you confirm Ben + Carmen are available for a 30-minute kickoff on Tue Apr 5 at 10:00am PT?
2) Please confirm the dataset cadence (bulk upload vs streaming) and whether we can use a 2-week slice of production-like data for the evaluation.

If that timeline looks tight, we can shift to Apr 11 start.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0123

> Sr. Director, IT Compliance
> Lighthouse Systems

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>

Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC next steps and evaluation checklist for Lighthouse Systems

Hi Carmen + Ben —

Thanks for the quick reply. A few technical clarifications and what I’m attaching: redwood-network-reqs.pdf (firewall & peering checklist) and a sample flow log export (sanitized) so your security team can validate.

Measurement & dashboards:
- We’ll report latency (p50/p95/p99), throughput (req/s), and token usage per request via the Redwood Console dashboard (link below). We also export a weekly CSV and a final evaluated cost sheet at the end of the POC.
- Token cost calculation: total tokens consumed / completed interactions; we’ll show both raw and optimized (with batching/cache) numbers so you can see delta.

Maintenance windows: none planned for the POC unless required — we’ll notify 48h in advance for any rolling upgrades.

I’ll draft a one-page incident runbook and post it to the shared drive before the kickoff; attaching the network checklist now.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

- Carmen: please confirm the security team contact and preferred method to receive the sanitized flow log sample.

Next steps after kickoff: 1) Integration checklist complete, 2) Short smoke test, 3) Controlled load run. We’ll use the checklist to gate progress and produce a short weekly status note every Friday during the POC.

If anything changes on your side before kickoff, ping me and I’ll adjust the plan. Excited to get started.
